intent: Edge panel for secondary tasks. Floating sheet inset from the opening edge.

eyebrow.note: Short area name in the header row, 12px, like Billing · Invoices. Caller-provided.

tone.note: Tone icon (16px, aria-hidden) and status word from KitLabels (info, success, warning, danger) before the eyebrow, so status is never colour alone. neutral shows the eyebrow only.

side.note: Floating sheet with radius-surface-lg. Right/left inset from top, bottom, and the opening edge. Bottom is centered. Top insets from top, left, and right. Not a flush full-bleed bar. Below 480px (30rem) left and right open as the bottom sheet (full width inside the 16px inset, no handle, no swipe).

size.note: Width for left/right/bottom sheets (layout-drawer-*). Use lg when the body has DatePicker or other overlays that must fit without horizontal scroll. Top stays full width.

children.note: Body. Kit blocks that know the Drawer adapt: SideNav fills the body (no rail width, border or card frame) and stays open.

footer.note: kit Buttons. Left/right: one row, actions on the right (Cancel, then one primary), size sm. Bottom and the 480px sheet stack them full width, actions first, then footerStart; on bottom use shape=pill and block.

footerStart.note: Left of the footer actions, first in the footer tab order: an Ask Button (appearance outline, mode neutral, size sm, iconStart MessageCircle) or a count like 6 of 6 selected. Labels are caller-provided.

passthrough.note: Not the portal or overlay. Focus trap, Escape, scroll lock and focus return are kit-owned.

requirements: Title (h2, the shared ModalCard header) is the accessible name, description is aria-describedby when present
Focus starts on the first field in the body, not Close; with no field the panel itself takes focus
Focus is trapped while open and the page behind is inert
Escape closes, unless an open panel inside it (Select, DatePicker) handles that Escape first
Scroll lock keeps the scrollbar gutter
Focus returns to the opener on close (Escape, Close or overlay click); if the opener is gone, to the page heading (or main)
built-in labels (close) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default

doNot: Do not invent Sheet, SidePanel, or local Drawer
Do not add snap points or swipe
Do not skip the close control unless showClose is false AND footer/body still provide a way out. Overlay click and Escape still close.
snippet: <Drawer open={open} title="Pick a delivery time" description="We'll prepare your order as soon as possible." side="bottom" showClose={false} onClose={close} footer={<><Button appearance="solid" mode="primary" size="lg" shape="pill" block>Confirm Delivery Time</Button><Button appearance="outline" mode="neutral" size="lg" shape="pill" block onClick={close}>Cancel</Button></>}><RadioGroup name="delivery-time" legend="Delivery time" hideLegend layout="card" defaultValue="standard" options={slots} /></Drawer>
